adr: 0162 — A destination is three things and two of them were owed; 2814 — The viewer does what the tables say of views
review_scope: Whether navigation coordinates are tested after a page's effective crop-origin and inherited page rotation transform
original_claim: A destination specifies page, viewport location and magnification; Table 149 coordinates are default user space. ADR 2814 applies page/crop/UserUnit transformation and retains coordinates across navigation.
current_evidence: Code composes `pdf_model::content::page_space_at` in `Open::user_corner`; page size and transform are based on effective inherited page attributes. Existing public navigation tests independently verify non-origin CropBox transforms and XYZ null retention at Rotate 0. Separate page geometry tests independently verify clockwise 90/270 mapping, but no found navigation assertion combines the two.
decision: The implementation path and ADR rationale remain supported by sampled evidence; no code defect is established. Add a composition test rather than revise either ADR: a named destination on a cropped page with inherited Rotate90/270, compared with direct GoTo for the same view and independent point arithmetic.
residuals: The candidate covers only one XYZ point and two right-angle rotations. It does not claim every Fit form, all four rotations, UserUnit, ViewArea preferences or every media/crop boundary combination.

adr: 0118 — The page transform from default user space to device geometry
review_scope: Source-derived rotation direction and crop offset used only to build the expected coordinate values
original_claim: Table 31 rotates clockwise when displayed; default-space points map through the cropped page transform before raster placement.
current_evidence: Primary Table 31 marks CropBox and Rotate inheritable and defines Rotate clockwise. Table 149 requires destination coordinates in default user space. For CropBox [50,80,550,780], point (150,680) has offset (100,600). Clockwise 90 maps this offset to (600,400); clockwise 270 maps it to (100,100).
decision: No conflict found. The test oracle expresses these transforms as point arithmetic and independent expected view origins, rather than consulting the production transform routine.
residuals: Review is limited to this coordinate derivation; no whole-ADR or page-transform certification.
